query: Two issues: (1) rounding 32 floors 1080→1056 instead of rounding up; (2) IndexError when crop is enabled with a mask attached — caused by Load Image passing a 64x64 placeholder mask when none was drawn/edited.

desired.outcome: OP diagnosed and maintainer kijai (2026-04-02) confirmed: open the mask editor and save (even unchanged) to replace the 64x64 placeholder; maintainer promised a guard. Rounding stays floor-by-design — maintainer reluctant to change existing workflows' behavior.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause class; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct for this workflow.
